title.narrative: DFA CSF04-22 Y1 Payment for Ensuring a just and equitable renewable energy

description.narrative: The ‘Ensuring a just and equitable renewable energy transition for Global South communities’ project in countries such as DRC aims to ensure that the renewable energy transition is just and equitable for indigenous, impoverished, and traditionally marginalised communities. The objectives are to strengthen civil society by building an alliance between civil society organisations in the Global South, linking this coalition to advocacy efforts in the Global North and in China. Global Witness Trust will work in partnership with AFREWATCH, headquartered in the DRC, who advocate for the fair, equitable and transparent development of natural resources in Africa for the benefit of all. The key activities include identifying target actors, geographies and activities to investigate, producing two investigations to demonstrate barriers to the renewable energy transition for Global South countries and expose harmful impact on communities, and engaging key stakeholders in international forums and regions/countries (EU, US, UK) on their policies and initiatives for the renewable energy transition.
